paragraphs.source_en: In 1697, the Fire Ox year of the twelfth Tibetan calendrical cycle, he was recognized by the Tibetan regent Desi Sangye Gyatso as the reincarnated child of the Fifth Dalai Lama. At the time of the Butter Lamp Festival that same year, the Sixth Dalai Lama Tsangyang Gyatso held his enthronement ceremony in the Sishipingcuo Hall of the Potala Palace, attended by Tenzin Dalai Khan, Desi Sangye Gyatso, and other Tibetan and Mongolian clerical and lay officials. Taking the larger situation into account, the Qing emperor Kangxi sent Changkya Khutukhtu and others to attend the ceremony, and bestowed countless treasures.

paragraphs.source_en: In 1698, the Tibetan Earth Tiger year, Tsangyang Gyatso went to Drepung Monastery, formed his first religious ties, received textual transmission from the opening of the Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment, and began to hear scriptures on Buddhist doctrine. In addition, he studied a great many exoteric and esoteric scriptures under the Panchen Lama, the abbot of Ganden Monastery, and accomplished masters of the Sakya, Gelug, Nyingma, and other schools. paragraphs.source_en: The age in which Tsangyang Gyatso grew up coincided with political turmoil in Tibet, when various internal and external conflicts began to appear one after another. In 1700, the Tibetan Iron Dragon year, Tenzin Dalai Khan died in Tibet. His second son, Lhazang Luwai, then came to Ü-Tsang and inherited his father's position. Among the Mongol patrons, this gave rise to two opinions, one approving and one opposing. Moreover, the Desi had long kept secret the passing of the Fifth Dalai Lama, which aroused the displeasure of the Qing emperor Kangxi. Within Tibet, the Desi's arbitrary rule, his long concealment of the death, and such conduct as wearing monastic robes while openly keeping a “chief consort” provoked discontent among some leaders of Drepung and Sera monasteries, and so on.

paragraphs.source_zh: 仓央嘉措成长的时代，恰值西藏政治动荡，内外各种矛盾接连不断地开始出现之际。1700年（藏历铁龙年），丹增达赖汗在西藏去世。其次子拉藏鲁白遂来至前藏，承袭了乃父职位。蒙古施主当中对此也产生了赞同与反对的两种意见。另外，第悉对第五世达赖喇嘛的圆寂进行了长期保密，这引起了清朝康熙帝的不满。在西藏内部，由于第悉独断专行，长期“ 匿丧”，身穿袈裟而又公开蓄养“主母”等行为，招致哲蚌寺、色拉寺部分首脑表现出不满情绪，等等。

paragraphs.source_en: In 1702, in the sixth month of the Tibetan Water Horse year, when Tsangyang Gyatso was twenty, the Desi urged him to receive the bhikshu vows. He heeded the advice. He went to Tashilhunpo Monastery to meet the Panchen Lama, Lobsang Yeshe. The biography of the Fifth Panchen Lama says: “Not to mention his receiving the bhikshu vows, he even cast aside, irresistibly, the novice vows he had previously taken. In the end, all of us, with myself at the head, begged him not to change into lay clothing, but to receive the bhikshu vows while keeping the vows of a lay devotee and to turn the wheel of the Dharma. But in the end it had no effect, and we had no choice but to report the circumstances in detail to the Desi. After staying at Tashilhunpo Monastery for seventeen days, Tsangyang Gyatso returned to Lhasa.” From then on, according to The Autobiography of the Fifth Panchen Lobsang Yeshe, The Moon That Clearly Reveals Conduct, page 209, Tsangyang Gyatso put on lay clothing and acted as he pleased. By day he shot arrows, drank wine, sang songs, and played wantonly at the Dragon King Pond. He also went out to the outskirts of Lhasa to amuse himself, sought pleasure with young women, and abandoned his vows.

paragraphs.source_zh: 1702年（藏历水马年六月），仓央嘉措20岁时，第悉劝其受比丘戒。他听从劝告。前往扎什伦布寺与班禅大师洛桑益西相见。第五世班禅的传记里说，“休说他受比丘戒，就连原先受的出家戒也无法阻挡地抛弃了。最后，以我为首的众人皆请求其不要换穿俗人服装，以近事男戒而受比丘戒，在转法轮。但是，终无效应，只得将经过情形详细呈报第悉。仓央嘉措在扎什伦布寺居17日后返回拉萨。”（《五世班禅洛桑益西自传·明晰品行月亮》 209页）自那以后，仓央嘉措便穿起俗人衣服，任意而为。白天在龙王潭内射箭、饮酒、唱歌，恣意嬉戏。还到拉萨近郊去游玩，与年轻女子寻欢作乐，放弃了戒行。

paragraphs.source_en: Lhazang Khan exploited the conflict between the Sixth Dalai Lama Tsangyang Gyatso and Desi Sangye Gyatso, creating ever more trouble. After reports spread that the Desi had attempted to poison Lhazang Khan, the conflict between the Tibetan monastic field of merit and the Mongol patrons became still sharper. In January 1705, the Tibetan Wood Bird year, the Sixth Dalai Lama, the Gyishö depa, the Lhamo oracle, the abbots of Sera and Drepung, chief officials of the government, representatives of the Panchen Lama, and the Mongol patrons assembled to discuss how to resolve the conflict. At last they resolved that Desi Sangye Gyatso would resign his post in the local government, and that Kunga Dzong would be assigned to him as an estate for his sustenance; Lhazang Khan would retain the title “Mongol King of the Local Government” and return to Qinghai to pasture his herds. In reality, however, neither side intended to carry out the resolution. After leaving Lhasa, Lhazang Khan stayed for many days in places such as Yangbajing and Damxung, and slowly arrived at Nagqu. At Nagqu he gathered Mongol troops from various parts of northern Tibet and prepared for war. Using as a pretext that the Desi had not observed the resolution and was still staying inside the Potala Palace interfering in all affairs of government, he turned back from there toward Lhasa. In May of that year, at Damxung, Lhazang Khan divided the Mongol army into two columns: one, led by himself, came by way of Phenpo; the other, led by his wife Tsering Tashi and several officers, came by way of Doilungdêqên. At that time, the masters of Sera and Drepung, the ritual preceptors of the tantric college, and representatives of the Panchen Lama, hearing the news, hurried one after another to dissuade him. They pleaded with the khan to halt his troops. But they were refused. In July 1705, the Wood Bird year of the twelfth Tibetan cycle, Desi Sangye Gyatso was captured, escorted to Langzi village in Doilungdêqên, and immediately beheaded. From then on, the Mongol Lhazang Khan ruled for roughly twelve years in all.

paragraphs.source_zh: 拉藏汗利用第六世达赖喇嘛仓央嘉措与第悉·桑结嘉措之间的矛盾，制造越来越多的麻烦。第悉企图投毒杀害拉藏汗的说法传开以后，藏蒙福田、施主之间的矛盾更加尖锐。公元1705年（藏历木鸡年）一月，第六世达赖喇嘛、吉雪第巴、拉木降神人、色拉、哲蚌二寺堪布、政府各要员、班禅大师的代表、蒙古诸施主等，集议如何解决矛盾。最后议决，第悉·桑结嘉措辞去地方政府的职务，将贡嘎宗拨给他作为食邑；拉藏汗保留“地方政府蒙古王”的称号，返回青海驻牧。但是，实际上双方都没有打算执行决议。拉藏汗从拉萨出发以后，在羊八井、当雄等地驻留多日，缓缓抵达那曲。在那曲集结了藏北各地的蒙古军队，准备打仗。他借口第悉未遵守决议，仍然呆在布达拉宫内干预政府的一切事务，从那里折返拉萨。当年5月，拉藏汗在当雄将蒙古军队分为两路，一路由他亲自率领，从澎波而来；另一路由其妻次仁扎西及部分军官率领，从堆龙德庆而来。当时，色拉、哲蚌二寺的上师、密宗院的轨范师以及班禅大师的代表等人闻讯后，急忙先后赶去劝阻。请求汗王罢兵。但是，遭到拒绝。公元1705年（藏历第十二绕迥木鸡年）七月第悉·桑结嘉措被抓获，押至堆龙德庆的朗孜村立刻斩首。从此以后，蒙古人拉藏汗统治前后长达12年。

paragraphs.source_en: After Lhazang Khan seized great power, he reproached the Sixth Dalai Lama in many ways. He also specially sent men to the capital to slander Sangye Gyatso, saying that he had colluded with the Dzungars and was preparing to rebel against the court. He also said that the Tsangyang Gyatso whom Desi Sangye Gyatso had enthroned in the Potala Palace was not the true reincarnated child of the Fifth Dalai Lama, that he spent all day sunk in wine and women and did not observe monastic discipline, and he requested that he be deposed and replaced. Emperor Kangxi thereupon sent Assistant Minister Heshou and others to Tibet, conferred upon Lhazang Khan the title “Khan Who Assists the Dharma and Is Respectfully Obedient,” and bestowed on him a gold seal. He ordered that Tsangyang Gyatso be removed from his position in the Potala Palace and “seized and presented to the capital.”

units.source_en: After Lhazang Khan seized great power, he reproached the Sixth Dalai Lama in many ways.

paragraphs.source_zh: 拉藏汗掌握大权以后，对第六世达赖喇嘛多方责难。还特派人员赴京师，谗言桑结嘉措勾结准噶尔人，准备反叛朝廷。还说，第悉 ·桑结嘉措在布达拉宫立的仓央嘉措不是第五世达赖喇嘛真正的转世灵童，他终日沉湎于酒色，不守清规，请予废立。康熙帝即派侍郎赫寿等人赴藏，敕封拉藏汗为 “翊法恭顺汗”，赐金印一颗。命将仓央嘉措从布达拉宫的职位上废除，“执献京师”。

paragraphs.source_en: In accordance with the imperial edict, after Tsangyang Gyatso was deposed, he was soon “escorted” to Beijing. When he was being seen off at Samye Lingka in front of Drepung Monastery, the monks of Drepung forcibly seized him and took him into the monastery's Ganden Phodrang Palace. When Lhazang Khan heard the report, he immediately sent troops to surround Drepung Monastery, while the monks also prepared armed resistance; a bloody conflict between the two sides was about to break out. Seeing this, Tsangyang Gyatso could not bear it in his heart, and of his own accord walked into the Mongol army, immediately calming the battle that was on the verge of erupting. After that, while taking the northern route to the capital, he passed away upon reaching Gungganor in Qinghai, at the age of twenty-five. This is the common account given in the biographies. Therefore, in the Potala Palace alone there is no reliquary stupa for the Sixth Dalai Lama.

paragraphs.source_zh: 遵照谕旨，废掉仓央嘉措以后，不久即“解送”北京。在哲蚌寺前的参尼林卡为其送行时，哲蚌寺僧人将其强行抢至该寺的甘丹颇章宫中。拉藏汗闻报后，立即派兵包围了哲蚌寺，寺僧们亦准备武力抵抗，双方即将发生流血冲突。仓央嘉措见此情形于心不忍，便自动走到蒙古军中，立地平息了这场一触即发的战斗。然后，从北路进京，抵达青海的贡噶诺尔时圆寂，时年25岁。这是传记中的普遍说法。所以，布宫里唯独没有六世达赖的灵塔。
